授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 固体・気体・液体の異なる相が混在して相互に作用しながら運動する流れを多相流または混相流という。混相流は、気液、固気、固液、液液二相流等の形で、工学的にもしばしば重要となる流動現象である。本講では、混相流の基礎について学んだ後、軽水炉システムにおける特に重要な気液二相流現象に注目し、その伝熱流動特性について理解を深める。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Multiphase flow is a flow in which different phases (solid, gas, and liquid) are mixed and moved while interacting. Multiphase flow, in the form of gas-liquid, solid-gas, solid-liquid, and liquid-liquid two-phase flows, is a flow phenomenon that is often important in engineering and has been researched both experimentally and analytically in a vast field.
In this class, at first, we give the introduction to some fundamental concepts of multiphase flows. Then we will focus on gas-liquid two-phase flow, which is a very important phenomenon in the light water reactor systems, to understand the heat transfer and flow characteristics in the reactor systems.
